title: HTTP/3 Extended CONNECT RFC 9220 Foundation Work Item
summary: Add the RFC 9220 HTTP/3 Extended CONNECT scalar and validation foundation without building a full WebSocket tunnel.
planned_changes:
- Add SETTINGS_ENABLE_CONNECT_PROTOCOL to the typed HTTP/3 settings model, writer, and parser.
- Add RFC 8441-style Extended CONNECT request pseudo-header validation and expose `:protocol` on validated request results and materialized requests.
- Add unsupported-protocol 501 response creation with optional problem-details payload.
- Add closure mapping helpers for orderly FIN and reset-to-H3_REQUEST_CANCELLED behavior.
- Add focused unit tests and canonical spec xrefs.
- Narrow the RFC 9220 planning gap to record this foundation as trace-owned.
verification_plan: Run the focused HTTP/3 Extended CONNECT, settings, and header-validation test subset, validate core SpecTrace JSON artifacts, regenerate QUIC requirement coverage triage, and confirm diff hygiene.
out_of_scope: WebSocket frame parsing, masking, and message reassembly.
Bidirectional tunnel forwarding between HTTP/3 streams and TCP sockets.
HTTP Datagram, CONNECT-UDP, CONNECT-IP, and MASQUE support.
Changing QUIC transport packet, TLS, scheduler, or stream-state behavior.
completion_notes: The HTTP/3 adapter now has a trace-owned RFC 9220 foundation for settings, Extended CONNECT validation, unsupported-protocol response behavior, and closure mapping.
